about: The hub hands the task over in the owner's exact words; the executor answers the owner itself, and the result of its turn becomes the reply to the owner's message; the hub gets REPLIED. "Done" only when explicit.

actions.text:
[hub:m7 from hub] Task from the owner (#m5). Their words:
> Work out the September payouts
The Stripe figures are needed.
Task d7: its record is `hub task show` (the owner, the hub and whoever set it read it); context, decisions and what you did along the way — append there with `hub task note "<what>"`.
The result of this turn goes to the owner as the reply to their message: write it as a reply to them. Do the technical steps yourself; business decisions — to the owner as options (AskUserQuestion), wait for the answer; report what was done. An interim report is not the end of the turn: keep working in this same turn, end it when the task is done or has hit an owner's decision. Made something visible (a page, a UI) — show it: a link and a screenshot or a video through `hub send-file`. Proposing something visible (a PR, a mockup, a UI option) — before the question form, send a "this is how it will look" snapshot (`hub shot` → `hub send-file`): a card has no picture. Something long (a full test run, Docker, a build — longer than ~5 min) — first a quick check of the main thing (one test, curl, a snapshot), the full run in the background (run_in_background), and end the turn with the line "started X, will write the result" (~N min only if it is known: the same run before, a measured pace; no measure — no number): the owner sees a long turn without news as a disappearance. A page answers 403 or a bot protection — do not get around it with search and caches: at once `hub tools request browser:<name>` and read it in the browser; the same with any missing tool (a service — its MCP). Do not ask the owner what you can find out yourself. The language of everything you write is English: the turn's result, "waiting…", every line between steps — also when command output, notifications and skills are in another language.
[hub:m10 from core] REPLIED d7: pay replied to the owner on m5: "September payouts: $12,400"
